divergences.notes: Strict did:key remains Multikey-first, so the contract follows the Rust multikey rendering rather than the older JS 2020-suite document shape.
Strict did:key representation stays Multikey-first and application/did+ld+json in line with the current library contract.
Strict did:key dereferencing returns Multikey verification methods rather than the JS Ed25519VerificationKey2020 shape.
Strict did:key is Multikey-first for all supported multicodecs, including X25519.
Strict did:jwk remains JWK-native rather than converting the method into a Multikey document.
Strict did:jwk representation stays JWK-native and application/did+json.
Strict did:jwk dereferencing returns JsonWebKey content rather than a Multikey conversion.
Strict did:jwk remains JWK-native for RSA as well; this case is tracked even though the current JS contract is asserted more loosely in tests.
The library keeps sourceUrl-style did:web metadata instead of the ssi deactivated:null metadata shape.
did:web representation metadata follows the fetched source URL contract rather than the ssi metadata shape.
did:web dereferencing keeps the current sourceUrl-oriented contract.
Path-based did:web resolution follows the same sourceUrl metadata contract as root did:web resolution.
Path-based did:web dereferencing follows the current library metadata contract instead of the ssi metadata shape.
